column2: [intro]
I'm a bit naïve, it's my specialty,
I get swept away by their simplicity,
They speak with ease, with great eloquence,
And I fall into their trap with innocence.
I latch on to everyone, it’s my weakness,
Easily convinced, without much finesse,
All the smooth talkers, the persuaders,
I latch on to everyone, even the deceivers.
Enticing promises, they spin my head,
I get caught up in their abstract threads,
They use their smiles like deadly charms,
And I find myself trapped by their chaotic alarms.
I latch on to everyone, it’s my weakness,
Easily convinced, without much finesse,
All the smooth talkers, the persuaders,
I latch on to everyone, even the deceivers.
[ solo ]
I latch on to everyone, but I'm growing bit by bit,
I’m starting to understand, not to be misled by wit,
Maybe one day I’ll become more cynical,
But for now, I still cling to all that’s whimsical.
[ outro ]
